newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open little changed.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open mostly flat Wednesday based on market orders at 1018 EDT, traders said.
Tuesday, prices settled unchanged across the board in thin trade. December cotton ended at 74.58 cents a lb.
Technical support remained at 74.00 cents followed by 72.00 cents for December delivery.
Industry sources said the market remains gripped with uncertainty over the condition of the 1997/98 crop and by a lack of fundamental news. Players await USDA's August supply and demand report.

Weather Services Corp noted favorable conditions for cotton in Texas and the Southwest. In the Southeast, rain damage to crops from Tropical Depression Danny was limited. Cotton in most areas remains in good condition with development slightly behind schedule, WSC said.
